title: dialog.listen body v1
description: Request a scoped NO-WAKE listening window from jv-ears (the bounded exception to wake-every-time approved 2026-08-22). Ears opens the window and publishes transcripts normally; the REQUESTER interprets them — ears stays dumb. Used by jv-act (confirmation answers) and jv-brain (onboarding/follow-up questions). Envelope conf = 1.0.

listen_id.description: UUID for correlating logs; not echoed in transcripts.

window_s.description: Seconds the no-wake window stays open. Hard-capped: this must never become an open mic.

reason.description: Why the window was requested — audited, and the HUD will show it (sensor truthfulness, invariant 10).
